questions.prompt: Groups helping Democrats have spent $815K in the MT Senate race. Are Democrats playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Republicans hold this seat now, so money helping Democrats here is offense.

questions.prompt: Groups helping Republicans have spent $8.6M in NY's 3rd District House race. Are Republicans playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Democrats hold this seat now, so money helping Republicans here is offense.

questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
HMP (a super PAC) has spent $2.3M in VA's 2nd District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Democrat or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: CLF (a super PAC) has spent $6.0M in CO's 8th District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Republican or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: In the final 20 days, a campaign gets a $2,000 check. What must it do?
questions.why: Contributions of $1,000 or more received in the last 20 days must be reported within 48 hours on Form 6.

questions.prompt: Can a super PAC give $10,000 directly to a House candidate's campaign?
questions.why: Super PACs can raise unlimited money but can't give to candidates or coordinate with them. They can only spend independently.

questions.prompt: In CA's 13th District House race, outside money favors Republicans by $4.1M. Whose nominee has raised more?
questions.why: Outside money and candidate money point opposite ways here: the Democrat leads fundraising by $2.2M.

questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
A super PAC airs a $1,000 ad on Oct. 20. How fast must it tell the FEC?
questions.why: From Oct. 15 to Nov. 1, independent expenditures of $1,000 or more must be reported within 24 hours.
